title: ai.json
description: spm skill manifest: declares target vendors and skill git dependencies.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

targets.description: Vendors the skills are materialized for.

resolveTransitive.description: Opt in to transitive skill dependencies: when true, spm reads each resolved skill's own co-located ai.json and recursively resolves the skills it declares. Default false. Read only from the root project's manifest; a dependency's nested ai.json cannot re-enable it.

allowedSources.description: Source allowlist: every skill and plugin source (direct or transitive) must match one of these patterns, matched against the protocol-independent repo identity so HTTPS, SSH-URL and scp-style spellings are equivalent. Patterns: `host/org/repo`, `host/org/*` (`*` = one or more further path segments), `host/*`, or `file://*` (local paths and file:// URLs, otherwise denied). Hosts are case-insensitive, paths are case-sensitive, `.git` is ignored. An empty list allows nothing. Intersected with the machine policy ($SPM_HOME/policy.json or SPM_POLICY). Read only from the root project's manifest; a dependency's nested ai.json cannot set it.

skills.description: Skill dependencies, keyed by local name.

plugins.description: Full-plugin dependencies (agents, MCP servers, hooks, scripts and bundled skills), keyed by local name. The `path` points at a Claude Code plugin root (a directory containing `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`).

git.description: Git repository URL (https, ssh, scp-style, or file://).

version.description: Semver requirement (e.g. `^1.2`, `~1.4.0`, `>=1.2, <2`; a bare `1.2` means `^1.2`) resolved to the highest matching semver tag (`v1.4.1` or `1.4.1`). Non-semver tags are ignored, and prereleases only match when the requirement names one.

path.description: Subdirectory within the repo (monorepo of skills).
